dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High visibility of horizontal light bands across the greater and median coverts created by thick white fringes contrasting sharply with dark feather centers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence and sharp boundary sharpness of pale edges along the folded flight feathers against the dark primary/secondary bodies.

other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally high-contrast dorsal scalloping throughout due to broad white margins on almost all visible feathers.
